Once upon a time:
there was a bear who had a problem. He was confused and didn't know what to do. He looked around to see if he could find someone to help him, but no one was there. He started to cry.
Suddenly, he heard a voice. It was coming from the other side of the mountain. He saw a little girl, who had been trapped in the mountain. She shouted in a loud voice.
The bear stopped crying and asked the girl why she was crying. The girl explained that she was stuck in the mountain. She said she had been searching for him, but in a way like that was going to be a big problem.
The bear felt so sorry for the girl. He smiled and said, "I can help you. I will use my powerful arms to push the rocks and we can find your way out!" The girl thanked him and the bear pushed and pushed until the rocks were finally in the way.
The girl smiled and thanked the bear. They both said goodbye and the bear went back to the mountain to have a better friend.

, in a small town, there was a little girl named Lucy. Lucy loved to play with her soft toy cat, Fluffy. One day, Lucy and Fluffy went outside to play in the garden. They found a big, long stick. Lucy had an idea. "Let's have a picnic, Fluffy!" she said.
Lucy and Fluffy took the soft blanket and set it on the grass. They put some food on the blanket. Lucy and Fluffy sat down to eat their lunch. They had yummy sandwiches, fruit, and cookies. They talked and laughed under the warm sun.
After lunch, Lucy and Fluffy played a game of catch. They threw the ball high in the sky and tried to catch it. They had so much fun on that warm day. When it was time to go home, Lucy took her soft blanket and held Fluffy's leash. They walked back to their house, tired but happy after their fun day of play.
